description:
We are building somethingEPIC.

Evestia Clinical is a biotech-focused global CRO delivering authentic expertise and personalized support where client need it most.

Our foundation is built on four core principles: Innovation drives us to seek new solutions, Excellence defines the high standards we keep, and genuine Care ensures a supportive culture for both our patients and our people. We foster Partnership in everything we do, believing that working together—with trust and flexibility—is the key to success.

Our approach is agile by nature and personalized by design. This translates to a workplace where you are empowered to find the creative solutions necessary for our collective success. We offer a welcoming, flexible, and supportive culture that values trust and belonging, ensuring you have the support needed to grow your skills and thrive while making a difference. We partner with our clients to provide expert knowledge and guidance through complex clinical trials in rare disease, oncology, neurology, immunology, and inflammation. At Evestia Clinical, you will become a vital part of a global specialist CRO. This means you will deliver life changing impact through clinical excellence.

We are committed to creating development opportunities that allow your skills to grow right alongside ours. If you are inspired by this collaborative environment and ready to change the lives of patients worldwide, we’d love to welcome you to our team.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Pharmacovigilance Physician to provide medical leadership and expert oversight of safety data across investigational and marketed products. In this role, you will be responsible for the medical review and assessment of Individual Case Safety Reports (ICSRs), proactive signal detection and evaluation, and the review of periodic aggregate safety reports, including PBRERs and PSURs.

You will also work closely with our Medical Affairs team, providing specialist medical input and supporting the clinical medical monitoring team. This position offers the opportunity to contribute across both pharmacovigilance and broader clinical functions, helping to ensure the ongoing safety and benefit-risk assessment of the products we support.

What will your job look like?

Pharmacovigilance & Safety Operations

  • Perform robust medical review of ICSRs from clinical trials and post-marketing projects, ensuring accurate assessment of seriousness, causality, and expectedness/labeledness.

  • Review and ensure the medical accuracy and appropriateness of MedDRA and WHO Drug coding for adverse events and concomitant medications.

  • Author scientifically valid medical assessments, company comments, and concise medical summaries for complex or serious reported events.

  • Author safety-related queries to investigative sites or reporters to ensure complete and accurate clinical data collection.

  • Review and contribute to cumulative analyses of similar adverse events to support regulatory reporting and safety evaluations, including Analysis of Similar Events (AOSE) where applicable.

  • Provide medical support, guidance, mentoring, and training to the PV team, as required.

  • Review scientific literature to identify potential safety signals or valid ICSRs.

  • Apply sound medical judgment and clinical expertise to provide advice, data interpretations, and strategic guidance to PV and other internal functional departments, clients, and external partners.

  • Provide medical input for responses to regulatory authority requests, inspections, and sponsor audits and safety inquiries

Aggregate Reporting & Signal Management

  • Provide crucial medical input, review, and approval for periodic post-market and clinical safety reports, including PBRERs, PSURs, and DSURs.

  • Participate in active and routine signal detection activities. Evaluate potential safety signals, review safety data trends, and contribute to signal validation and assessment reports.

  • Contribute to integrated benefit-risk assessments throughout the product lifecycle and provide medical interpretation of evolving safety profiles.

  • Participate in or present safety data at internal Safety Management Committees (SMCs) or Data Safety Monitoring Boards (DSMBs) or sponsor safety governance meetings as contracted, providing medical interpretation, clinical context, and recommendations to support informed safety decision-making.

  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of Risk Management Plans (RMPs) and provide medical input for Safety Management Plans (SMPs).

  • Provide flexible, occasional support to the clinical medical monitoring function to ensure project continuity during peak workloads or team absences.

  • When supporting clinical operations, assist in responding to site investigators regarding protocol eligibility, safety concerns, and data management queries.

  • Perform ad-hoc medical review of clinical trial data listings, laboratory reports, and subject profiles to ensure medical accuracy and identify potential safety concerns.

Quality & Regulatory Compliance

Ensure all pharmacovigilance and medical monitoring activities comply with applicable global regulations (e.g., ICH-GVP, ICH-GCP, FDA, EMA), SOPs, and client requirements

Education:

  • Primary medical degree (e.g., MD, MBBS, MBChB, DO or equivalent) from an accredited medical school is required.

  • Active or previously held medical license/registration is required.

Experience:

  • A minimum of 2 years of experience as a physician in the pharmaceutical industry or a CRO, with a primary focus on Pharmacovigilance and Drug Safety.

  • Proven, hands-on experience performing medical review of ICSRs.

  • Experience with aggregate safety report (PBRERs, PSURs, DSURs) review and generation is a plus.

  • Working knowledge of global regulations regarding drug safety and pharmacovigilance (ICH, FDA, EMA).

  • Strong scientific, clinical, and analytical knowledge with excellent ability to read, analyze, and interpret scientific data.

  • Demonstrated ability to analyze and interpret complex scientific and clinical data.

Competencies & Skills

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with Investigators, clients, and regulatory authorities.

  • Highly proficient in utilizing electronic applications, specifically the ability to efficiently navigate clinical and pharmacovigilance safety databases to conduct medical reviews and extract data.

  • Ability to exercise independent medical judgment and make timely, evidence-based decisions in time-sensitive situations, including complex safety assessments, benefit-risk evaluation, signal management, and clinical trial eligibility support when required.

  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams and with external stakeholders.

  • Strong knowledge of MedDRA and WHO Drug coding dictionaries.

What we offer you in return?

We believe that to do your best work, you need the best support. That's why we care deeply about your wellbeing, personal development, and achieving a true work-life balance.

As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to influence patient safety on a global scale while working with talented colleagues who share a passion for scientific excellence. We offer a collaborative and flexible working environment, opportunities for professional growth, and the chance to contribute to meaningful work that ultimately benefits patients around the world.

Ready to Take the Next Step?

Does joining Evestia Clinical and making a global impact excite you? Then it's time to apply!

We are eager to meet ambitious candidates. Remember, we hire for potential and passion. Therefore if you feel you're a good fit but don't meet every single requirement, please submit your application anyway. We want to hear from you.

description:
ESQlabs is an innovative, internationally active Contract Research Organization (CRO) and a global leader in the development and application of the Open Systems Pharmacology (OSP) Suite. We combine mechanistic modeling, Physiologically Based Pharmacokinetics (PBPK) and Quantitative Systems Pharmacology (QSP), with software and training to support Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) and Next-Generation Risk Assessment (NGRA) for pharmaceutical, chemical, and academic partners worldwide. Our mission is to empower life sciences: helping scientists understand mechanisms of disease and chemical toxicity to optimize individualized, safer, and more efficient treatment and testing strategies.

We are building a platform where AI agents help scientists set up regulated modeling analyses, and fixed, versioned procedures run them. This job is about the engine room: the compute core, the release pipeline and the operations.

About the role

You make sure our analyses can be reproduced, shipped to clients and checked later. You own the compute core, the release pipeline, deployment into client environments, and the metering and provenance behind every result. The AI layer has its own lead and team; you build what they run on. The Quality Manager sets the standards, you implement them. You report to the CEO.

Key Responsibilities

  • Make the scientific compute core deterministic: pinned R, Python and solver toolchains, content-addressed container images with a software bill of materials, and tests that prove byte-identical re-execution on a reference platform and tolerance-bounded re-execution across platforms.

  • Build the services the AI layer runs on: isolated executors per client without network access, usage metering per call, the signed record and the certificate behind every result. You build the policy engine and the tool router together with the AI lead.

  • Expose the platform as a versioned API and as tools for AI agents with one shared contract, and ship the reproducibility package that re-executes a run outside the platform.

  • Run the evaluation pipeline in continuous integration: conformance tests against reference case sets, re-execution tests, regression tests, results stored per procedure version.

  • Own release engineering and operations: CI/CD pipelines, signed and content-addressed releases, scripted installation qualification, environment management (hosted, in a client tenant, later offline), monitoring, incident handling and the operating model the deployment engineer runs.

  • Implement the technical controls behind the information security and AI management standards the Quality Manager owns.


What you bring

  • At least five years of platform, infrastructure or backend engineering with senior ownership of a production system.

  • Reproducible builds and execution in practice: dependency pinning, artifact hashing, immutable versioning, supply chain integrity. Hermetic build systems are a strong plus.

  • Kubernetes or a similar orchestrator, monitoring, and release management for environments you don’t fully control.

  • API design where the schema was a contract with external consumers, including versioning and deprecation in practice.

  • Security engineering for multi-tenant systems: isolation, secrets, authorization, and awareness of the risks of language-model-driven systems. Exposure to GxP or equivalent regulated software is valuable; interest in acquiring it is required.

What's in store for you

The dynamic team behind ESQlabs unites people with different backgrounds, spanning disciplines like pharmaceutical sciences, physics, bioinformatics, mathematics, data science, and software engineering. Our trust in each other, our open-mindedness, and our constant quest for excellence and innovation unite us. We value flat hierarchies, where everyone can contribute ideas and expertise to develop the best product. We are passionate, always willing to broaden our horizons, and love our start-up culture.

You will also benefit from:

  • Flexible work hours and a home office policy that focuses on people and not on numbers

  • An attractive remuneration package

  • Regular in-person team gatherings at locations across Europe.

  • A clearly defined technical problem with a commercial consequence, and the authority to solve it properly rather than quickly.

  • A working environment in which your contribution will make a difference, and that allows you to take ownership of projects and processes

  • A small, senior team that owns an open-source platform used by regulators and pharma, and the mandate to set the standard for certified scientific software.

  • Responsibility, autonomy, participation, and career perspective

About us

We collaborate with global corporations in the pharma and chemical industry, as well as start-ups in the life-science technology sector and academic and non-profit research institutions. We define new standards in pharmacometrics and systems pharmacology and toxicology areas. Our software and model platforms help scientists understand mechanisms of diseases and chemical toxicity to optimize individualized treatment of patients and protect the health of the animal and human life.

ESQlabs has attracted international players as sponsors for the OSP Software development. In addition, funding through national and EU-wide research grants allows us to develop our core technologies continuously.

For more information about our culture, values and benefits visit our Unique career opportunities - esqLABS GmbH.

ESQlabs is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of background, and value the diversity of perspectives this brings to our team.

Blue Origin is seeking a Principal ASIC Test Engineer to lead production test strategy for RF, mmWave, and mixed-signal integrated circuits within Silicon Systems.

This individual contributor role serves as the technical lead for final test of mmWave front-end ICs and converter-intensive ASICs, with focus on RF/mmWave performance, high-speed ADC and DAC testing, manufacturability, and cost of test.

excerpt: BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals.
description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description: The Director, Global Regulatory Project Management (Director, Global RPM) is a senior strategic leader responsible for supporting, influencing, translating, and executing oncology regulatory strategies across the global drug development lifecycle. This role combines deep regulatory expertise with advanced project management and organizational leadership, driving successful NDA/BLA/MAA submissions and ensuring seamless cross-functional integration across regions. The Director, Global RPM proactively anticipates regulatory challenges, influences decisions, and champions process improvements to secure on-time submissions and maintain market access for products worldwide

Essential Functions of the Job:

Strategic Global Leadership

  • Support, translate, and implement global regulatory strategies for development programs, ensuring alignment with business objectives and long-term vision across all major regions (US, EU, China, APAC, LATAM, etc.).
  • Serve as a principal advisor to the Global Regulatory Lead (GRL) and Regulatory Regional Leads (RRL), providing strategic regulatory oversight and recommendations for global product development, submissions, and lifecycle management.
  • Integrate functional regulatory expertise with PM knowledge to solve complex problems and make sound decisions for the organization on a global scale.
  • Maintain awareness of global regulatory environments, policy trends, and competitive landscapes, assessing impact and adapting strategies accordingly.

Global Project Management Excellence

  • Lead and manage complex regulatory submissions (IND/CTA, NDA/BLA/MAA) across multiple regions, ensuring compliance with ICH, US, EU, China, and other international requirements.
  • Act as the “COO” to the Global Regulatory Lead, translating strategic regulatory vision into actionable project plans, driving operational execution, and ensuring all cross-functional activities are coordinated and delivered on time.
  • Organize and facilitate cross-functional meetings with global teams to coordinate, plan, and track submission activities, driving accountability and alignment among stakeholders worldwide.
  • Proactively identify risks, propose solutions, and manage critical issues related to global regulatory submissions and strategy.
  • Oversee preparation and submission of documentation to support investigational and marketing registration packages, ensuring timelines and quality standards are met globally.

Cross-Regional Collaboration

  • Build partnerships with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams (clinical, medical, safety, CMC, commercial) across regions to achieve strategic business goals through knowledge sharing and collaboration.
  • Liaise and negotiate with cross-functional teams and regulatory authorities to expedite submission timelines and resolve key regulatory issues in all relevant markets.
  • Mentor, guide, and develop junior and mid-level staff in project planning, regulatory processes, and professional development, fostering a global mindset.

Continuous Improvement

  • Champion process optimization and improvement initiatives within the global regulatory PM function.
  • Lead the development and implementation of regulatory processes and policies, fostering a culture of excellence and innovation across regions.

Eaton’s Electrical division is currently seeking a Technical Program Manager - New Product Introduction & Production Ramp Up. This is a remote position with up to 25% anticipated travel.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

Eaton's fastest-growing data center segment seeks an experienced Project Manager for new product introduction and production ramp-up. The role involves managing complex, multi-team projects and requires proven success in delivering results on time and within scope. Candidates should possess technical expertise and strong interpersonal skills to drive accountability across teams.

What you’ll do:

  • Own end-to-end project management across multiple concurrent projects — from scoping and scheduling through execution, risk mitigation, and closeout.
  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans (scope, schedule, budget, critical path) aligned to business case commitments and stakeholder expectations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams spanning engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, finance, and commercial functions across multiple geographies and time zones.
  • Drive accountability without direct line authority — influencing team members, functional managers, and senior leaders to maintain commitments and resolve roadblocks.
  • Leverage technical understanding of project work to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, identify risks early, and validate that deliverables meet requirements.
  • Identify, assess, and proactively manage project risks and issues; develop mitigation plans and escalate as appropriate to keep projects on track.
  • Establish a consistent project reporting cadence: prepare and present project status updates, metrics dashboards, and executive summaries to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Facilitate structured phase-gate and milestone reviews; coordinate readiness assessments across commercial, technical, and operational dimensions.
  • Drive alignment on scope, priorities, and resources across sites and functions — resolving conflicts constructively and creating clarity where ambiguity exists.
  • Manage project change control — evaluate change requests for schedule, cost, and scope impact, and obtain approvals before implementation.
  • Conduct lessons-learned sessions at project closeout and contribute to continuous improvement of the project management processes, tools, and standards.
  • Partner with functional leaders to staff projects appropriately and clearly define team member roles and accountabilities.

This role could be the next step in your career if you demonstrate the following experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, or a related technical discipline from an accredited institution.
  • Minimum 5 years of progressive project or program management experience, with demonstrated success delivering complex, multi-stakeholder projects.

You will set yourself apart by demonstrating some or all of the following:

  • Eaton PROLaunch or PMP (Project Management Professional) certification
  • Experience in a manufacturing, industrial, or engineering-intensive environment.
  • Familiarity with ProLaunch, PMBOK, or equivalent stage-gate project management frameworks.
  • Lean / Six Sigma Green Belt or higher; experience applying CI tools in a project context.
  • Proficiency with project management software (MS Project, Smartsheet, Jira, or similar) and the Microsoft Office suite.
  • Experience managing projects across international sites or in a global matrix organization.

Keys to role success:

  • Proven track record of managing multiple concurrent projects from initiation through closeout, consistently meeting schedule, scope, and quality commitments.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams — including remote and matrixed team members — and achieving results without direct authority.
  • Sufficient technical understanding of the subject matter (manufacturing, engineering, or operations processes) to ask the right questions, identify gaps, and validate work products.
  • Results orientation: A bias for action and accountability — tracks commitments relentlessly and creates urgency across teams without creating conflict.
  • Influencing without authority: Skilled at building relationships and credibility across functions and levels; uses data, logic, and interpersonal skill to align stakeholders and move work forward.
  • Technical curiosity: Asks sharp, informed questions; understands enough about engineering or operations work to spot risk, call out gaps, and push back constructively on estimates or plans.
  • Structured communication: Presents complex project status clearly and concisely to executive, technical, and operational audiences; tailors message to the room.
  • Risk thinking: Anticipates problems before they become crises; proactively surfaces issues with proposed solutions rather than just escalating problems.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable managing ambiguity and shifting priorities across a dynamic, multi-project environment; adjusts plans without losing sight of end goals.
  • Cross-cultural collaboration: Builds effective working relationships across geographies, functions, and organizational levels; inclusive of diverse perspectives and work styles.

excerpt: The OpportunityFutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to leadLoomwork, an AI automation venture.
description:
The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to leadLoomwork, an AI automation venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Loomworkis an AI automation agency for growing companies. Every growing company knows AI is its next growth lever, but few have the people to turn it into working systems. Implementation is the scarce resource.Loomworkhelps them find where AI will pay off, builds agents into the tools they already use, and keeps those agents running. It launches as a services business with a dedicated technical delivery team from day one. Every engagement also serves as research: as client work converges on one segment, Loomwork turns its library of deployed agents into a connected product and grows from agency to software company.

Market Context

The global AI consulting services market is valued at $11.9B in 2026 and is projected to reach $73.9B by 2034, growing at a 25.6% CAGR. North America holds about 38% of the market. Enterprise AI adoption climbed from 20% in 2017 to 88% in 2025, and adoption is outpacing the talent available to deploy it. Roughly 190,000 US and Canadian companies fall in the $10M to $300M revenue range, which puts the serviceable market at an estimated $3B a year. Most of these companies are too large for freelancers and too small for enterprise firms.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven venture building team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

  • Investor and advisor network across the industry and early-stage capital markets

  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight’s cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the direction of the venture and lead its execution.

  • Strategy: Shape the service offering, pricing, and positioning, and choose the segment to specialize in based on where demand converges

  • Customer Development: Win engagements with growing companies, move clients from assessment to build to retainer, and build the go-to-market motion

  • Product: Partner with the FutureSight delivery and engineering team to turn repeated client builds into reusable agents and, ultimately, a connected product

  • Capital: Lead future fundraising, supported by FutureSight's network and the agency's traction

  • Team: Recruit and lead the founding team, including a technical leader as the product takes shape, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company

  • Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS go-to-market, including sales and customer engagement

  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital

  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent

  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company

  • Direct exposure to AI implementation, consulting, or selling technology services into growing companies

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

description:
THE COMPANY
Established in early 2024, at Analogue Insight we are bridging the Analogue and Digital Worlds for Tomorrow through our Chiplet Solutions. Our core expertise lies in developing cutting-edge Chiplet technology that serves as the building block for advanced communication systems. Our Chiplets are designed to offer high performance, scalability, and integration flexibility, enabling our clients to achieve breakthroughs in computation speed, data processing, and connectivity. For more information about us, check out our website (Analogue Insight) and LinkedIn Page (Analogue Insight™: Overview | LinkedIn).

THE ROLE
We are seeking a talented and motivated Graduate Digital Design Engineer to join our team and contribute to the design and verification of digital and mixed-signal IP for our chiplet solutions, including PCS (Physical Coding Sublayer) logic and custom high-speed interfaces such as UCIe, Ethernet and PCIe. Working alongside experienced digital and analog engineers, you will write RTL, build testbenches and behavioural models, and see your work go into customer silicon. This role is well suited to recent graduates with a strong foundation in digital design who want to learn fast through hands-on work in a small, high-impact team.
Hiring Manager:Christian Borelli, Founder and CSO.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • RTL Design: Design and implement digital blocks for PCS and interface IP (e.g. encoders/decoders, scramblers, PRBS generators/checkers, FIFOs, CDC logic, control and calibration state machines) in Verilog/SystemVerilog, under the guidance of senior designers.
  • Standards & Specifications: Study SerDes and UCIe standards and architecture documents, and help turn them into clear block-level specifications.
  • Verification: Build testbenches and run simulations to verify your designs, using SystemVerilog, UVM or cocotb, and help develop verification plans and coverage.
  • Mixed-Signal Modelling: Write behavioural models of analog blocks in Verilog/SystemVerilog (and Verilog-A where needed) to support mixed-signal and top-level simulation with the analog team.
  • Implementation Support: Gain exposure to synthesis, lint, CDC checks and static timing analysis, and learn how design choices affect power, performance and area.
  • Scripting & Automation: Use scripting (e.g. Python, TCL or shell) to automate simulation, regression and reporting flows.
  • Documentation & Process: Document your designs and test results clearly, and contribute ideas to improve our design and verification environments and procedures.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with an experienced team of digital, analog and layout engineers across products such as UCIe, Ethernet and PCIe.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
Must-have Technical skills:
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related field (recent graduates and those graduating within the next 6 months are welcome)
  • 0–2 years of experience in digital design, including internships, placements or university projects
  • Solid understanding of digital logic fundamentals: synchronous design, finite state machines, timing, pipelining and clock-domain crossing
  • Hands-on experience writing RTL in Verilog or SystemVerilog, through coursework, thesis, FPGA or internship projects
  • Experience with an HDL simulator (e.g. Xcelium, VCS, Questa or open-source tools such as Verilator or Icarus)
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail

Soft & Professional Skills:
  • Clear, structured communication in professional English—able to explain complex results concisely
  • Collaborative and feedback-oriented mindset
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers
  • Strong ownership, reliability, and follow-through
  • Curious, self-motivated attitude, eager to learn and explore new tools or methods
  • High level of integrity and professionalism in representing the company and handling sensitive information.
Nice-to-have:
  • Exposure to verification methodologies such as UVM, SystemVerilog assertions or cocotb
  • Basic knowledge of synthesis, static timing analysis or place-and-route
  • Familiarity with high-speed serial interfaces or protocols (e.g. UCIe, Ethernet, PCIe) or line coding (e.g. 8b/10b, 64b/66b)
  • Awareness of Design-for-Test concepts (scan, BIST) and hardware/software co-design
  • Scripting skills in Python, TCL or shell, and comfort in a Linux environment
  • FPGA prototyping experience

Soft & Professional Skills:
  • Clear, structured communication in professional English—able to explain your work concisely
  • Collaborative and feedback-oriented mindset, open to learning from design reviews
  • Strong ownership, reliability, and follow-through
  • Curious, self-motivated attitude, eager to learn and explore new tools or methods
  • High level of integrity and professionalism in representing the company and handling sensitive information.

OUR CULTURE
We’re a fully remote team of around 45 people distributed across the UK, Armenia, Italy, the US, Estonia, India, and beyond. We believe great talent is everywhere!
  • Our values are our north star: We Grow Together, We Win Together. Excellence Builds Relationships. Trust Is Our Currency. Results Matter, but People Create Them.
  • Connected, even remotely: We invest intentionally in staying connected through regular all-hands, 1:1s, technical reviews, and informal coffee chats, so collaboration feels natural and human despite the distance.
  • High ownership, real impact: Everyone contributes directly to customer-facing IP. Your work doesn't disappear into layers of management – it ships.
  • How we work: We move fast but thoughtfully, communicate openly, and balance autonomy with support. Technical decisions are debated openly and grounded in data, trade-offs, and first-principles thinking.

WHY JOIN US
  • Remote-first flexibility – work from anywhere, with flexible hours
  • Equipment & setup – we'll provide the tools you need to succeed
  • High-impact projects – design real digital and mixed-signal IP used in customer silicon, from your first months
  • Mentorship from day one – a dedicated manager and experienced engineers who will review your work and help you grow
  • Competitive, transparent compensation – adjusted for your location and engagement model
  • Learning & growth – structured onboarding, AI–DLP sessions, technical deep dives, and peer-led knowledge sharing that build both technical depth and system-level perspective

RECRUITMENT PROCESS
  1. Founder Call (30 min) – mutual introduction and interest alignment
  2. Technical Interview (90 min) – fundamentals, reasoning, and problem-solving
  3. Optional: Second Technical Interview (60 min) – another deep-dive into specific topics, which might include a presentation that we'll let you know about in advance
  4. HR & Culture Call (45 min) – values, collaboration style, and ways of working
  5. Offer & Next Steps – we send the offer and kick off the onboarding process.

Disclaimer: This is our standard process for most roles. For more senior, specialized, or higher-authority positions, we reserve the right to amend or tailor these steps as we see fit.

If you don’t meet every requirement but feel excited about the role, apply anyway. We value curiosity, integrity, and potential as much as experience.

Because the design work is done in-house by our Programme Scientists, our trainers get something rare: a fully built, properly researched session, briefed to them in advance, delivered to a cohort who have already been diagnosed and who are expecting to work rather than watch.

Job Summary

You will deliver live sessions, typically 90 to 150 minutes, mostly online, working from a session design and a written brief prepared for you by the Programme Scientist.

This is a delivery role, and deliberately so. You are not asked to write content, find clients, or sell anything. You are asked to be outstanding in the room. Based on the seniority and ability of the applicant there will also be an opportunity extend this role to a follow-up coach with the same group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver live sessions to our designed structure, to a consistently high standard.

  • Prepare from the written brief you receive at least five working days before each session — preparation time is paid within the session fee.

  • Run structured practice: our sessions are built around participants doing the thing, not listening to it explained. Expect to spend much of each session facilitating small-group work, giving feedback, and coaching in the moment.

  • Manage the room — including the sceptical senior participant, the quiet group, and the one who wants to debate rather than practise.

  • Submit brief written session notes within 48 hours of every session, so the Programme Scientist can adjust what comes next.

  • Take part in accreditation before your first client session, and stay open to observation and feedback afterwards.

Qualifications

Essential

  • 5-10 years of substantial experience in facilitating live learning or development sessions for professional or managerial audiences in a corporate setting.

  • Genuinely strong online delivery — confident running breakout groups, keeping cameras on and energy up, and handling the mechanics without it disrupting the session.

  • Comfortable delivering material you did not write, to a structure you are asked to keep to. This is the single most important requirement of the role.

  • Skilled at running practice and giving direct, useful feedback to adults — rather than presenting.

  • Reliable on the administrative side: punctual, responsive, and consistent with session notes.

  • Fluent, credible professional English, and comfortable with senior audiences.

Desirable

  • Experience in one or more of: leadership and management development, communication and influence, collaboration, resilience and change, or working across cultures.

  • A coaching qualification, or experience delivering one-to-one as well as group work.

  • Additional languages, or experience delivering to international cohorts working in a second language.

  • Familiarity with evidence-based learning design — you do not need to be a researcher, but you should be interested in why a session is built the way it is.

How the engagement works

  • Paid accreditation first: a methodology induction, then you deliver a full session for our Programme Scientist to observe, paid at half the standard session fee. Accreditation is completed before any client-facing work.

  • You are then briefed and booked per session. Fees are paid per session with preparation included, invoiced on delivery, on 30-day terms.

  • Standard contract terms apply, including confidentiality, intellectual property assignment for anything created in connection with the work, and non-solicitation of our clients. These are shared in full before accreditation.

  • If a client cancels at short notice, you are protected: cancellations inside five working days are paid in full.

excerpt: Über DrAnsayDrAnsay wurde 2018 gegründet und gehört heute zu den führenden digitalen Gesundheitsplattformen in Deutschland.
description:
Über DrAnsay

DrAnsay wurde 2018 gegründet und gehört heute zu den führenden digitalen Gesundheitsplattformen in Deutschland. Als digitales HealthTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Patient:innen, Ärzt:innen und Apotheken und entwickeln technologische Lösungen, die Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher, schneller und zugänglicher machen. Mehr als 1 Million Patient:innen nutzen unsere Plattform bereits. Unser Anspruch ist klar: digitale Medizin so zu gestalten, dass sie im Alltag wirklich funktioniert.

Wir arbeiten schnell, direkt und mit viel Eigenverantwortung. Wer zu uns kommt, übernimmt nicht einfach nur eine bestehende Rolle, sondern gestaltet Strukturen, Prozesse und Entscheidungen aktiv mit.

Warum es diese Rolle gibt

DrAnsay befindet sich in einer Scale-up-Phase: Die Grundstrukturen der Produktorganisation stehen. Der Fokus liegt jetzt auf Optimierung, Effizienz und der Weiterentwicklung bestehender sowie neuer Produktinitiativen. Unser CPO verantwortet gleichzeitig kommerzielle und strategische Themen der Unternehmensführung. Neue Initiativen brauchen deshalb eine Person, die produktübergreifend Struktur schafft und den Takt hält.

Die Position wird neu geschaffen, um diese Lücke zu schließen. Das ist keine Rolle, in der du Grundlagen aufräumst. Es geht darum, dass wir neue Produkte schneller starten und bei bestehenden Produkten an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten.

Deine Rolle

Als Head of Product übernimmst du die Koordination produktübergreifender Roadmaps und OKR-Zyklen, verantwortest das unternehmensweite Produkt-Reporting und sorgst dafür, dass Metriken, Feature-Impact und Produktstrategie intern klar kommuniziert werden. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO und bist Schnittstelle zu einem neunköpfigen Produktteam aus Senior Product Managern und einem UX-Team sowie zu Data, Marketing und Engineering.

Dein Ziel in den ersten Monaten ist es, alle Produktbereiche, unseren Markt und das Team gründlich zu verstehen. Du erkennst, wo Planung, Zusammenarbeit und Dokumentation besser werden können, machst einen Plan und setzt ihn um.

Was du konkret machst

  • Produktübergreifende Roadmaps über mehrere Produktlinien und Teams hinweg koordinieren, aktuell halten und Abhängigkeiten zwischen Teams früh erkennen und auflösen

  • OKRs und Key Results auf Team-Ebene mit der übergeordneten Produktstrategie verknüpfen und die Zyklen von der Planung bis zur Auswertung begleiten

  • Die Produkt-Metriken und das unternehmensweite Reporting zum Feature-Impact verantworten, gemeinsam mit unserem Data-Team

  • Vorhaben hinterfragen, die zu wenig Kunden- oder Geschäftswert schaffen, und Alternativen vorschlagen

  • User Research strukturiert in laufende Produktentwicklung einbinden, gemeinsam mit unserem Head of UX und dem UX-Team

  • Die Arbeitsweise unserer Product Manager weiterentwickeln, besonders Planung, Dokumentation und Reporting

  • Product Discovery und die frühe Teamstrukturierung neuer Produktinitiativen unterstützen, inklusive Abstimmung mit Engineering

  • Die unternehmensweite Kommunikation zur Produktstrategie aufbauen und Produktentscheidungen für alle nachvollziehbar dokumentieren

Requirements

Das brauchst du

  • Erfahrung in einer Product-Leadership-Rolle, etwa als Head of Product, Product Lead oder Group Product Manager. Du hast über dein eigenes Produkt hinaus Verantwortung getragen, für mehrere Product Manager, Teams oder Produktbereiche, fachlich oder disziplinarisch

  • Erfahrung mit digitalen Produkten für Endkund:innen (B2C) in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen

  • Praxis mit OKRs und Roadmapping: Du hast OKR-Zyklen produktübergreifend koordiniert und Roadmaps für mehrere Teams gepflegt und kommuniziert

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Produktkennzahlen: Du hast Metriken definiert, Feature-Impact gemessen und Reporting für interne Stakeholder aufgebaut

  • Du überzeugst über Argumente und Zahlen, nicht über deine Position, und diskutierst auch mit erfahrenen Product Managern auf Augenhöhe

  • Die Bereitschaft, auch die Strukturarbeit selbst zu machen: Roadmaps pflegen, Updates einfordern, Reporting am Laufen halten

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens C1), weil du täglich in beiden Sprachen mit Product, Engineering und Leadership arbeitest

  • Du kannst die Tätigkeit dauerhaft aus Deutschland ausüben und verfügst zum Start über die hierfür erforderliche Arbeitserlaubnis

Das fällt positiv auf

  • Erfahrung als Head of Product. Voraussetzung ist sie nicht

  • Mehrjährige eigene Produktverantwortung als Product Manager, bevor du in eine Leadership-Rolle gewechselt bist

  • Erfahrung aus einer größeren Produktorganisation mit ausgereiften Arbeitsweisen

  • Erfahrung mit Roadmap- und Produktmanagement-Tools wie airfocus, Productboard, Jira Product Discovery oder Aha!

  • Erfahrung mit Produktanalyse-Tools wie PostHog, Amplitude oder Mixpanel

  • Produkterfahrung in E-Commerce, Marktplätzen oder Digital Health

  • Erfahrung in stark regulierten Produktumfeldern

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit UX-Teams und der Einbindung von User Research

Was wir bieten

  • Vollzeit und unbefristet, Start ab November 2026

  • 100% Remote: Du arbeitest aus Deutschland, Vollzeit, ohne Standortbindung

  • Eine Rolle, die mitwächst: Je tiefer dein Verständnis von Produkten, Markt und Team, desto mehr Entscheidungen übernimmst du

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem CPO und Zeit, alle Produktbereiche gründlich kennenzulernen

  • Sichtbare Wirkung: Du prägst, wie DrAnsay neue Produkte startet und woran das Product-Team arbeitet

  • Kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen, Low-Ego-Kultur und direktem Feedback

  • Ein Produkt mit realem Nutzen: Wir helfen täglich Menschen, Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher zu bekommen

Wie du dich bewirbst

Bewirb dich direkt über das Bewerbungsformular. Kein Anschreiben erforderlich, wir stellen dir einige kurze Fragen, die uns helfen zu verstehen, wie du arbeitest. Diese Antworten sind uns wichtiger als dein LinkedIn-Profil.

Du hörst von uns innerhalb von fünf Arbeitstagen.

DrAnsay ist ein chancengleicher Arbeitgeber. Bewerbungen werden auf Basis von Qualifikationen und Berufserfahrung bewertet. Alle Bewerbenden werden unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Herkunft, Behinderung, Religion oder anderen geschützten Merkmalen berücksichtigt. DrAnsay verarbeitet die mit deiner Bewerbung übermittelten personenbezogenen Daten zur Durchführung des Recruitingprozesses.

description:
Firmable's product depends on customer trust in how we handle their data. This role is the operational backbone of that trust: the controls you run are what let 1,000+ customers rely on Firmable with their data.

The Role

As our Security Engineer, you'll own the day-to-day execution of the security controls and policies that keep Firmable compliant against SOC 2 (all five TSC) and ISO 27001:2022. You'll report into the Security & Compliance team, fully remote and open globally. This is a hands-on operational role, not a paper-compliance one: you implement, monitor and continuously tighten the controls auditors and customers actually test against.

~90% hands-on execution: control implementation, continuous monitoring, evidence collection, vulnerability and access management.
~10% cross-functional: partnering with engineering on secure cloud config and shaping the program as it scales across frameworks.

What You'll Own

  • SOC 2 & ISO 27001 execution: implement and maintain controls across infrastructure, applications and internal systems; close gaps as they're identified

  • Security policy enforcement: put information security policy into daily practice across engineering and business teams, covering access control, data classification, incident response, vendor risk and change management

  • Continuous control monitoring: recurring access reviews, log reviews, vulnerability scans and patch cadence checks; organise evidence ahead of audits

  • Vulnerability management: triage scanner findings, coordinate remediation with engineering, verify closure

  • Identity & access management: onboarding/offboarding, least-privilege and MFA enforcement, periodic access recertification

  • Monitoring & incident response: watch security alerts and logs, triage and escalate per the incident response plan

  • Risk & vendor management: maintain the risk register and third-party risk assessments, track remediation to closure

  • Audit readiness: prepare evidence for annual assessments and respond to customer security questionnaires

  • Security awareness: run employee training and phishing simulations

Must haves

  • 2–5 years in security engineering, cloud security or infrastructure security, ideally with direct SOC 2 or ISO 27001 exposure

  • Working knowledge of the SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria and how technical controls map to them

  • Hands-on cloud security fundamentals (AWS preferred): IAM, logging/monitoring, vulnerability scanning

  • Comfortable executing policy day to day (access reviews, evidence collection, remediation tracking), not just writing it

  • Clear written communication and comfortable working async across time zones with a distributed team

Highly valued

  • Familiarity with GRC automation platforms (Vanta, Drata or similar)

  • Relevant certification (Security+, CySA+, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, or progress toward CISA/CISSP)

The Environment

Fully remote, open globally, working closely with a distributed Security and Engineering team across time zones. Real ownership over controls that directly protect customer trust, not a box-ticking exercise. Fast-moving, AI-native product team.

Why This Role

  • Real ownership: the controls you run directly protect the trust 1,000+ customers place in Firmable's data

  • Multi-framework exposure from day one: a live SOC 2 and ISO 27001 program, not a single-framework box-tick

  • Competitive compensation and flexible hours in a fast-moving, AI-native product team

This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

    • Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)

    • Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)

This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.

  • Own schema-drift handling, incremental vs. full-refresh strategy, idempotency and replayability, backfills, and late/duplicate-record handling.

Data Quality as a First-Class Deliverable

  • Build the tests, contracts, and monitoring that let stakeholders trust the numbers: freshness and volume checks, schema/type enforcement at the boundary, referential and uniqueness constraints, reconciliation against source-of-truth, and anomaly detection on business-critical metrics.
  • Ensure failures surface loudly and early — caught at the boundary, not discovered in a dashboard three days later.

Full Domain Delivery

  • Deliver the full pipeline for your domain: ingestion config, raw landing, dbt staging and mart models, data-quality tests, orchestration DAG, and runbook.
  • Stakeholders own the business definitions; you own translating them into correct, tested transformations — and you own the documentation that makes those definitions authoritative, traceable, and fuels our AI-ready environment.

Architecting an AI-Ready Single Source of Truth

  • Design domain data so it's clean, consistently grained, well-documented, and semantically unambiguous — the kind of SSOT that both dashboards and AI/agent-driven consumers can query reliably, without hidden business rules or hallucination.

Platform Reliability & Performance

  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability across your pipelines and their platform dependencies.
  • Ensure data freshness and system uptime meet defined service expectations; optimize pipeline performance, compute utilization, and system efficiency.

Engineering Standards

  • Maintain version-controlled data infrastructure and CI/CD workflows for your pipelines.
  • Set the reference implementation others follow — especially for ingestion and DQ, where the team currently lacks a pattern.

Mentorship & Collaboration

  • Review other engineers' work, pair on hard problems, and raise the team's bar — senior impact shows up through others, not only your own commits.
  • Translate business needs into data solutions directly with your domain's stakeholders; understand not just how to build it but why the business needs it built that way.

What You Bring

Required:

  • 5+ years building and maintaining production data pipelines.
  • Expert-level dbt — staging/mart architecture, incremental models, tests, macros, documentation, and exposures. This is non-negotiable.
  • Mastery of API-based data ingestion — authentication and token-refresh (OAuth2, keys), pagination, rate limiting, retry/backoff, and assembling incremental pulls into complete, correct datasets.

description:
Buscamos un Representante Técnico de Ventas responsable del desarrollo comercial y la venta consultiva de soluciones de Reología y Calorimetría Diferencial de Barrido (DSC), con foco principal en Reología y una responsabilidad complementaria en análisis térmico por DSC.

Esta posición combina prospección, desarrollo de cuentas, calificación técnica, demostraciones y cierre de ventas. Buscamos un perfil claramente comercial, con capacidad para abrir mercado y suficiente base técnica para conversar con formuladores, investigadores, responsables de calidad, proceso, laboratorio, compras y dirección.

Responsabilidades principales

  • Desarrollar comercialmente el portafolio de Reología y DSC en el territorio asignado, dedicando la mayor parte del esfuerzo comercial a soluciones de Reología.
  • Prospectar y desarrollar nuevos clientes en sectores como pinturas y recubrimientos, polímeros, adhesivos, farmacéutica, cosmética, alimentos, químicos, petroquímicos, lubricantes, baterías, academia, I+D y control de calidad.
  • Gestionar el ciclo completo de venta: identificación de oportunidades, calificación técnica, presentación de soluciones, elaboración de propuestas, negociación y cierre.
  • Identificar aplicaciones reológicas relacionadas con viscosidad y curvas de flujo, esfuerzo de cedencia, tixotropía, viscoelasticidad, estabilidad de formulaciones y comportamiento dependiente del tiempo, temperatura y frecuencia.
  • Identificar oportunidades de DSC para caracterización de transiciones térmicas, temperatura de transición vítrea (Tg), fusión, cristalización, curado, estabilidad oxidativa, polimorfismo, compatibilidad y pureza, según la aplicación.
  • Realizar presentaciones técnico-comerciales y coordinar demostraciones de reómetros y calorímetros DSC, con apoyo de especialistas de aplicación cuando sea necesario.
  • Asesorar al cliente en la selección de la solución adecuada de acuerdo con muestra, formulación, proceso, rango de temperatura, método de prueba, nivel de automatización y objetivos de medición.
  • Desarrollar relaciones de largo plazo con formuladores, investigadores, responsables de laboratorio, calidad, I+D, producción, proceso, compras y tomadores de decisión.
  • Cumplir los objetivos de venta trimestrales y anuales, así como los indicadores comerciales definidos por la gerencia.
  • Mantener actualizado el CRM con oportunidades, actividades, forecast, seguimiento comercial y etapas del pipeline.
  • Identificar oportunidades de venta cruzada con otras líneas de producto de la compañía.
  • Dar seguimiento postventa para asegurar la satisfacción del cliente, fortalecer la relación y detectar nuevas oportunidades de negocio.
  • Participar en capacitaciones técnicas y comerciales, ferias, seminarios, workshops y eventos especializados en México y en el extranjero.
  • Formación profesional en Ingeniería Química, Química, Materiales, Polímeros, Alimentos, Farmacéutica, Mecánica, Mecatrónica, Física, Nanotecnología o carrera afín con base técnica sólida.
  • Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en ventas técnicas B2B, indispensable, preferentemente de instrumentación científica, equipos analíticos, equipos de laboratorio, reómetros, viscosímetros, análisis térmico o soluciones para formulación, I+D y control de calidad.
  • Se valorará especialmente experiencia comercial o de aplicaciones en Reología/Viscosimetría, o experiencia vendiendo instrumentación a industrias donde la formulación y el comportamiento de flujo sean variables críticas.
  • Experiencia comprobable en prospección, apertura de cuentas nuevas, desarrollo de oportunidades y construcción de pipeline; no buscamos un perfil limitado únicamente al mantenimiento de cuentas existentes.
  • Capacidad para comprender una necesidad técnica y convertirla en una propuesta comercial de valor, sin perder el enfoque en avance de oportunidad, negociación y cierre.
  • Habilidad para comunicarse con perfiles técnicos y no técnicos: formuladores, investigadores, ingenieros, responsables de calidad, producción, laboratorio, compras y dirección.
  • Perfil altamente orientado a resultados, con disciplina para el cumplimiento de objetivos y seguimiento sistemático de oportunidades.
  • Manejo de CRM/ERP, forecast y metodología de seguimiento comercial.
  • Disponibilidad para viajar frecuentemente dentro y fuera del país.
  • Manejo de automóvil y disponibilidad para traslados en carretera.
  • Inglés intermedio conversacional indispensable para capacitación y comunicación técnica.

Experiencia deseable

Se dará prioridad a candidatos con experiencia directa en Reología o Viscometría, aunque no cuenten todavía con experiencia específica en DSC.

  • Venta, aplicación o uso técnico de reómetros rotacionales/oscilatorios, viscosímetros de laboratorio o sistemas de caracterización de flujo y viscoelasticidad.
  • Desarrollo, formulación o control de calidad de pinturas, recubrimientos, tintas, adhesivos, asfaltos, cosméticos, productos farmacéuticos, alimentos o formulaciones químicas.
  • Pruebas reológicas como curvas de flujo, esfuerzo de cedencia, tixotropía, barridos de amplitud/frecuencia/temperatura, recuperación estructural, creep o relajación.
  • Caracterización de polímeros, elastómeros, resinas, materiales fundidos, slurries, suspensiones, emulsiones, geles, pastas o materiales para baterías.
  • Experiencia en análisis térmico, DSC, DMA, TGA o técnicas relacionadas será considerada un valor adicional, pero no es un requisito indispensable.
  • Conocimiento de aplicaciones de DSC en polímeros o farmacéutica, incluyendo Tg, fusión, cristalización, curado, estabilidad, polimorfismo o pureza.

La prioridad es encontrar un vendedor técnico fuerte en Reología. El conocimiento de DSC puede desarrollarse mediante entrenamiento técnico y acompañamiento de especialistas de aplicación

Soluciones y tecnologías de la línea

Deseable familiaridad con Reología; el conocimiento de DSC puede adquirirse durante el proceso de capacitación. Las tecnologías incluyen:

  • Reometría rotacional y oscilatoria para líquidos, semisólidos, dispersiones, emulsiones, geles, pastas y materiales complejos.
  • Medición de viscosidad, curvas de flujo, esfuerzo de cedencia, tixotropía, viscoelasticidad, creep, relajación y recuperación estructural.
  • Barridos de amplitud, frecuencia, tiempo y temperatura; control de fuerza normal y accesorios para aplicaciones avanzadas.
  • Sistemas de medición y accesorios para formulación, control de calidad, polímeros, reología de polvos, tribología y caracterización especializada, según aplicación.
  • Calorimetría Diferencial de Barrido para Tg, fusión, cristalización, curado, estabilidad oxidativa, capacidad calorífica y caracterización térmica de materiales.

​​​​​​​Ofrecemos

  • Sueldo competitivo.
  • Bono por desempeño y esquema de comisiones.
  • Prestaciones superiores a las de la ley.
  • Herramientas de trabajo: automóvil, laptop y celular corporativo.
  • Capacitación técnica y comercial continua en México y en el extranjero.
  • Desarrollo profesional dentro de una empresa internacional líder en instrumentación científica.

The Company’s lead product candidate 4D-150 is designed to be a backbone therapy forming the foundation of treatment of blinding retinal vascular diseases by providing multi-year sustained delivery of anti-VEGF (aflibercept and anti-VEGF-C) with a single, safe, intravitreal injection, which substantially reduces the treatment burden associated with current bolus injections. The Company’s lead indication for 4D-150 is wet age-related macular degeneration, which is currently in Phase 3 development, and second indication is diabetic macular edema. The Company’s second product candidate is 4D-710, which is the first known genetic medicine to demonstrate successful delivery and expression of the CFTR transgene in the lungs of people with cystic fibrosis after aerosol delivery

GENERAL SUMMARY

The Senior Director of Clinical Quality Assurance (CQA) will provide strategic and operational Quality Assurance leadership and oversight for multiple, registrational, global 4DMT-sponsored clinical trials, ensuring trials are executed in compliance with applicable international regulatory requirements for Good Clinical Practice (GCP).

This position reports to the Executive Director, Quality Assurance and is accountable for advancing the CQA mission, objectives, and strategic plan through proactive quality strategy, risk-based oversight, inspection readiness, and continuous improvement of clinical quality systems.

MAJOR DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Provide strategic Quality leadership and oversight for multiple 4DMT Clinical Studies, including the followingstudy-specific activities:

  • Serve as a senior Quality partner to clinical study teams and leadership, providing guidance on GCP, ICH E6, and related regulations and guidance,, decision support, and escalation recommendations, including via attendance at Study team meetings, quality governance forums, and escalation discussions related to Clinical Study Quality Events.
  • Lead the development, implementation, and governance of Clinical Study Quality Plans for specific 4DMT clinical studies, with accountability for protecting subject safety/rights, data integrity, and GCP compliance across assigned studies and associated vendors.
  • Manage, mentor, and develop Clinical QA staff and consultants; establish clear goals, development plans, and succession depth.
  • Define, plan, perform, and/or oversee risk-based GCP Compliance audits of high-risk clinical vendors/sites, including clinical investigator sites
  • Ensure audit findings, quality risks, and CAPA commitments are communicated to senior stakeholders and collaborate with auditees and vendors to track, review, approve, assess the adequacy of CAPAs, and ensure timely escalation of unresolved or recurring issues
  • Provide senior Quality review and strategic input on Clinical documents, ensuring quality, accuracy, completeness, and inspection readiness of key clinical and regulatory documents, including as applicable Clinical Protocols, IBs, DSURs, Module 2.6 and 2.7 Tabulated and Written Summaries, and Integrated Summaries.

Lead and/or provide oversight for investigation and management of significant Clinical Study Quality Events:

  • Identify, communicate, and escalate significant incidents of GCP non-compliance, quality risks, and inspection-readiness concerns, and drive timely resolution, ensuring appropriate executive visibility, escalation, and risk-based decision-making.
  • Provide QA oversight for formal corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), ensuring actions are risk-based, effective, timely, and appropriately escalated to address identified Clinical Study Quality Events, including potential serious breaches of GCP.
  • Partner with CMC Quality, Clinical Operations, and senior cross-functional stakeholders to facilitate the investigation, escalation, and resolution of clinical supply quality issues such as temperature excursions, product complaints, and deviations reported from clinical sites, ensuring appropriate risk assessment, stakeholder communication, and CAPA linkage when applicable.

Champion and advance a culture of quality that fosters learning, respect, open communication, collaboration, integration, and teamwork:

  • Oversee and provide strategic direction for development of GCP compliance training materials and delivery of training to strengthen clinical quality culture and inspection readiness.
  • Partner with Clinical Operations, Clinical Development, Biometrics, Data Management, Medical Affairs, and Regulatory Affairs to embed proactive quality and risk management into study design and conduct.
  • Lead the development and continuous improvement of the Clinical Quality Management system through the development / refinement of Clinical QA processes

Our Mission

Healthcare should work for patients, but it doesn’t. In their time of need, they call down outdated insurance directories. Then wait on hold. Then wait weeks for the privilege of a visit. Then wait in a room solely designed for waiting. Then wait for a surprise bill. In any other consumer industry, the companies delivering such a poor customer experience would not survive. But in healthcare, patients lack market power. Which means they are expected to accept the unacceptable.

Zocdoc’s mission is to give power to the patient. To do that, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace that makes it easy to find and book in-person or virtual care in all 50 states, across +200 specialties and +12k insurance plans. By giving patients the ability to see and choose, we give them power. We’re 18 years old and the leader in our space, but we are still just getting started. If you like solving important, complex problems alongside deeply thoughtful, driven, and collaborative teammates, read on.

deine mission:

Du akquirierst und entwickelst Geschäftskunden insbesondere aus folgenden Bereichen:

  • Sportfachhandel

  • Sport- und Fitnesseinrichtungen, z. B. Fitnessstudios, Sportvereine, Leistungszentren und Hochschulsport

  • Sportmedizinische und therapeutische Einrichtungen, z. B. Sportärzte, Physiotherapien und Athletiktrainer

  • Wellness & Hospitality, z. B. Spas, Longevity-Center sowie Sport- und Wellnesshotels

das bringst du dafür mit:

  • Erfahrung als selbstständiger Handelsvertreter oder im B2B-Außendienst

  • Idealerweise ein bestehendes und aktives Netzwerk innerhalb einer oder mehrerer unserer Zielkundengruppen

  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger und hochwertiger Produkte

  • Unternehmerisches Denken und eigenständige Arbeitsweise

  • Sicheres und professionelles Auftreten gegenüber Geschäftskunden

  • Begeisterung für Sport, Performance, Regeneration und innovative Produkte

Besonders interessant ist eine Zusammenarbeit für Handelsvertreter, die bereits komplementäre, nicht konkurrierende Marken vertreten und Reboots sinnvoll in ihr bestehendes Portfolio integrieren können.

Wir suchen aktuell deutschlandweit.

Die konkreten Vertriebsgebiete werden gemeinsam anhand von Postleitzahlregionen definiert. Eine bundesweite Abdeckung ist ausdrücklich nicht erforderlich.

Entscheidend ist für uns nicht die Größe des Gebietes, sondern deine tatsächliche Marktpräsenz und dein bestehendes Netzwerk in der jeweiligen Region.

klingt spannend? das erwartet dich bei uns:

Dann möchten wir vor allem wissen, wo dein Netzwerk liegt und welche Kunden du bereits betreust.

Schick uns neben deinen Kontaktdaten gerne eine kurze Übersicht:

  • Welche PLZ-Regionen deckst du aktiv ab?

The successful candidate will: ● Coordinate multiple parallel projects and workstreams. ● Manage the PE Practice Leader’s EmmerScale calendar. ● Track deliverables, timelines, and action items. ● Maintain accurate Monday.com boards. ● Support Slack communication and information flow. ● Prepare meeting materials and follow-up. ● Update documentation and SOPs. ● Use Claude and other AI tools to accelerate administrative workflows. ● Support onboarding activity when needed. ● Provide light HubSpot administrative support. ● Ensure important details do not fall through the cracks. This is not a client-facing role. The coordinator may attend meetings in a silent support capacity to capture notes and action items, but will not lead meetings, contact clients directly, conduct outreach, or own client relationships. Key Responsibilities 1. Project Coordination ● Track multiple concurrent projects and workstreams across the Private Equity practice. ● Maintain visibility into action items, owners, deadlines, dependencies, deliverables,next steps, and project status. ● Follow up with internal stakeholders on outstanding tasks and deliverables. ● Help ensure nothing stalls, gets overlooked, or is dropped. ● Provide the PE Practice Leader with a clear view of what requires attention. ● Maintain accuracy and urgency while managing multiple simultaneous priorities. 2. Calendar Ownership ● Manage the PE Practice Leader’s calendar. ● Schedule and reschedule meetings. ● Coordinate availability across project and team calendars. ● Identify and resolve scheduling conflicts. ● Adjust meetings when priorities or availability change. ● Help prepare the Practice Leader’s calendar for upcoming work. ● Provide light calendar support for internal or non-PE Practice work when needed. 3. Slack Communication Support ● Support day-to-day communication flow within the client's Slack environment. ● Monitor assigned channels and relevant internal communications. ● Surface important information and outstanding action items. ● Post internal updates as directed. ● Help ensure requests communicated through Slack are captured and followed through. ● Maintain organized and timely communication across project teams. ● Use scheduled Slack messaging when appropriate to support different working hours and time zones. 4. Meeting Logistics & Follow-Up ● Prepare materials and documentation before meetings. ● Organize meeting-related information. ● Capture clear and structured notes. ● Identify decisions, action items, owners, and deadlines. ● Track follow-up responsibilities after meetings. ● Ensure actions are documented and completed. ● Attend meetings in a silent support capacity when required. ● Do not present, lead discussions, or independently engage clients. 5. Deliverable & Timeline Tracking ● Track deliverables, deadlines, milestones, and project commitments. ● Keep timelines current across active workstreams. ● Identify overdue or at-risk items. ● Follow up on approaching deadlines. ● Help maintain visibility into what is on track and what requires intervention. ● Provide concise updates to the PE Practice Leader. 6. Monday.com Board Management ● Maintain day-to-day project board hygiene. ● Update statuses and task progress. ● Maintain task ownership and due dates. ● Add updates when work progresses. ● Flag overdue items. ● Keep project information current and accurate. ● Work primarily within boards and structures already created by project leadership. ● Use basic Monday.com proficiency to support information sharing and project updates. 7. Documentation & SOP Support ● Maintain and update existing operational documentation. ● Update SOPs as processes change. ● Use meeting transcripts, notes, or instructions to revise documentation. ● Prepare updated drafts for review. ● Organize process information clearly. ● Maintain documentation so it remains accurate and transferable. ● Support Trainual or other knowledge-management systems when required. 8. AI-Assisted Workflow Execution ● Use Claude or another approved large language model as a daily work tool. ● Summarize meeting transcripts. ● Identify and organize action items. ● Prepare first drafts. ● Consolidate notes and information. ● Support recurring administrative workflows. ● Work within existing Claude Projects and established instructions. ● Use AI to increase speed, consistency, and accuracy. ● Apply sound judgment when reviewing AI-generated outputs. ● No advanced AI automation or technical build experience is required. 9. Onboarding Support ● Provide backup administrative support when new employees, contractors, brands, or projects are onboarded. ● Assist with onboarding trackers. ● Update timelines and checklists. ● Maintain document flow. ● Update Monday.com boards. ● Help coordinate onboarding-related information. ● Support existing onboarding owners rather than leading the process independently. 10. HubSpot & PE Business Development Support ● Provide light administrative support within HubSpot. ● Add new leads when directed. ● Update basic CRM records. ● Update deal stages. ● Maintain relevant activity information. ● Prepare brief summaries of PE business development activity when requested. ● Support the PE Practice Leader’s established processes. ● Do not independently prospect, conduct outreach, or own business development strategy. ● Basic HubSpot familiarity is sufficient; advanced proficiency is not required. 11. Time & Administrative Reporting ● Record working hours accurately in the approved time-tracking system. ● Support basic spreadsheet or administrative reporting when requested. ● Export and organize data when needed. ● Summarize time or project information. ● Flag discrepancies or missing information proactively. Requirements Required Skills & Experience ● Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, Communications,Project Management, or a related field. ● 2+ years of experience in project coordination, administrative support, operations,or a similar fast-paced professional environment. ● Exceptionally strong organizational skills. ● Ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams without losing accuracy or urgency. ● Experience using at least one project-management platform such as Monday.com,Asana, ClickUp, or equivalent. ● Experience tracking tasks, owners, deadlines, deliverables, and follow-upresponsibilities. ● Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. ● Strong general business acumen. ● High degree of common sense and professional judgment. ● Ability to identify priorities and context without being told every detail. ● Self-directed and comfortable working with minimal supervision. ● Reliable and consistent in completing recurring responsibilities. ● Proactive and intuitive in anticipating needs. ● High emotional intelligence. ● Coachable and receptive to feedback. ● Comfortable using Slack, Google Workspace, calendar systems, andproject-management tools. ● Practical experience using Claude or another LLM for everyday work. ● Technologically adaptable and able to learn software quickly. ● Comfortable working behind the scenes in a fast-moving professional environment. ● Able to handle confidential information with discretion. ● Available for a consistent 4-hour daily block, Monday through Friday. Preferred Qualifications ● Experience supporting private equity, conglomerates, holding companies,multi-brand organizations, consulting firms, professional services firms, or fractional teams. ● Familiarity with EOS/Traction, including Rocks, L10 meetings, and accountability structures. ● Basic HubSpot familiarity. ● Familiarity with Trainual or another SOP/LMS platform. ● Previous experience managing calendars for an executive, project leader, account leader, or consultant.
